title: Continuous Compliance Monitoring & Audit-Evidence Automation (CIS/STIG on Intune + Entra)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Prove your endpoints stay compliant — not just on the day you deployed
problem: Passing a CIS or STIG baseline once isn't the same as proving continuous compliance to an auditor months later. This solution gives you a repeatable way to monitor baseline drift and automate audit evidence for Intune + Entra endpoints in a federally regulated environment: measure current state against the baseline, detect drift, and export the evidence and POA&M-ready gaps auditors ask for — distinct from the one-time baseline build.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the continuous-compliance model (baseline → measure → detect drift → evidence/POA&M → remediate/track), how it complements a one-time CIS/STIG build, and where evidence comes from.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (an existing baseline, Intune/Entra roles + Graph read access, a reporting destination, evidence-retention needs, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to define the monitored control set, measure current vs baseline, schedule drift detection, and generate the audit-evidence and POA&M-ready gap exports, on a pilot then fleet-wide.

5 PowerShell scripts — control-state discovery, per-device baseline-conformance validation, an audit-evidence + drift/gap report (POA&M-ready), safe remediation of drifted settings (preview first), and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (control measured, drift detected, evidence exported), plus Best Practices for evidence retention and audit response.
short: Monitor baseline drift and automate audit evidence for CIS/STIG on Intune + Entra endpoints — measure vs baseline, detect drift, and export POA&M-ready evidence — distinct from the one-time build. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
